the generation and characterization of novel mAb to Vla-3.
the identification and characterization of novel monoclonal antibodies that may represent valuable reagents in the analysis of the role of integrins in normal and pathological conditions.
the identification of novel monoclonal antibodies against the alpha 3 integrin chain and the analysis of the distribution of Vla- 3 integrin in different normal and pathologic human tissues.
